name: satisfactory-aimod
description: Let your AI app read and act in a running Satisfactory game (survey, build, wire, run trains) via the SatisfactoryAIMod loopback bridge.
long_description: Connects an AI app to a running Satisfactory session that has the SatisfactoryAIMod installed. Exposes friendly, game-language tools (find resource nodes, place/connect buildings, power, logistics, save) plus read/action passthroughs for the full mod API. Local only; creative/cheat features stay gated in the mod. Requires Satisfactory running with the mod and a save loaded.

tools.name: game_status
tools.description: Check the game is connected and a save is loaded.

tools.name: find_resource_nodes
tools.description: Find resource nodes, filterable and nearest-first.

tools.name: list_buildings
tools.description: List placed buildings in an area.

tools.name: get_machines
tools.description: List production machines with recipe, clock, status.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Find recipe/item/building class ids by name.

tools.name: get_build_cost
tools.description: Real material cost of a build.

tools.name: check_location
tools.description: Is a spot solid ground / hazard / water?

tools.name: save_game
tools.description: Save and verify the file hit disk.

tools.name: place_miner
tools.description: Place a miner on a node.

tools.name: take_photo
tools.description: Frame and take a photo, then leave photo mode.

tools.name: list_game_methods
tools.description: Search the full low-level method catalog.

rpc_url.title: Game endpoint
rpc_url.description: The mod's local address. Leave as the default unless you changed the mod's port or enabled remote connections.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Set to 'true' to let the AI only LOOK at your game (no building, placing, or deleting). Leave empty for full access.
